user_constraint: Exclude paid videos and paid previews; use independent public works, not mirrors of the excluded paid course.

excluded.reason: User explicitly declined paid content; target chapter was not viewed.

observation_method: Actual browser playback, paused screenshots read with vision; currentTime/duration/paused and decoded dimensions read from the video DOM. No video download and no continuous full viewing.
capture_dimensions_note: All three decoded at 1920x1080. Saved page screenshots include a smaller displayed player; this is not 100-percent original-photo QA.
notes: Navigation target times and chapter metadata are not viewing timestamps. Actual paused currentTime values below are authoritative.
Observed examples are distinct photographs/poses, not a controlled before-after experiment.
Source facts and our transfer advice are recorded separately.
The candidate catalogs retain their original not-watched screening state; this file records subsequent actual playback. Unselected candidates were not watched.

videos.title: 【漫展摄影入门第三期】万用的漫展构图 九宫格构图
videos.author: 只是一只老羊
videos.access_observed: Actual video frames play; no paid-preview notice in the inspected page/frame.

frames.visible: Vertical Cos portrait with centered subject and chest-level hand gesture; subtitle says place subject in the middle. No crop operation or grid visible in this frame.
A different Cos photograph with grid divisions, face near the upper-right region, subject to the right and large background graphics on the left.

videos.transfer: Center and off-center examples both exist; assess whole subject, gesture and background before moving the head.
videos.limits: Two distinct photographs; no measured head movement or original-photo detail verification. Lecturer examples do not establish a compulsory grid rule.

videos.title: 实战怎么引导模特？5分钟讲透3个摆姿的底层逻辑！丨「如何上手拍写真·第22期」
videos.author: 肆周飞行
videos.metadata_screening: Page/player public metadata showed upower_exclusive=false and ugc_pay=arc_pay=0; details in candidates.json.
videos.access_observed: Actual frames play, including the later hand-pose section; no paid-preview notice in the inspected page/frame.

frames.visible: Photographer and standing model by a sofa; crossed leg positions, lowered arms and head turned downward/sideward. Subtitle discusses body center and overall framework.
Displayed seated portrait with elbow/forearm on sofa armrest, hips on seat, legs and shoes directed toward the lower right.
Behind-the-scenes low floor pose with bent knees and photographer; subtitle discusses using the body as support for hands.

videos.transfer: Establish comfortable overall posture and support before local head/shoulder/hand refinements. A body or prop can provide a concrete hand resting point when compatible with character action.
videos.limits: Behind-the-scenes viewpoint is not the captured photograph's camera viewpoint. No focal length, exact camera distance, weight-bearing foot or continuous movement inferred. Chapter names alone do not establish a viewed operation.

videos.title: 真正适合普通人的拍照坐姿，好看又自然！
videos.author: 李肥星
videos.metadata_screening: Page/player public metadata showed upower_exclusive=false and ugc_pay=arc_pay=0; details in candidates.json.
videos.access_observed: Actual frames play at initial, middle and closing portions; no paid-preview notice in the inspected page/frame.

frames.visible: Presenter demonstrates frontal sitting on a bench, arms along backrest, knees/feet together, whole shoes visible. Subtitle introduces frontal sitting.
Presenter seated on grass with legs extended forward; both shoes and hand positions visible. Image viewpoint looks downward more than the later sample.
Another grass sitting view with bent knees and hands near collar/upper torso; shoe profile, ground shadow and surrounding scene visible. Body-type commentary is not adopted as a retouch preset.
Presenter at a table giving closing commentary; no new pose or measured edit established.

videos.transfer: For shoe-preserving frames compare foot direction, knee lines, hand position and camera placement; inspect source silhouette and ground contact before postproduction shaping.
videos.limits: Different camera viewpoints and poses; no quantitative leg-length or slimming effect claimed. The video was not continuously watched, and no camera height or focal length was inferred from screenshots.
